name: CUBOID
description:
About This Game

CUBOID is a challenging spatial puzzle game with minimalist design, where you progress through a labyrinth of levels using a unique mechanic of merging with world blocks.

Features:

  • A unique 3D spatial puzzle based on an original concept.

  • Simple rules with truly challenging levels, perfect for puzzle enthusiasts.

  • Stylish minimalist design inspired by 1980s tech typography.

  • A completely solo creative project. The game was made by one person, including concept, programming, design, music, UI, fonts, and animations.
